title: Build a route for participation from risk and support functions
text: The source note places Legal, HR and IT involvement alongside rollout rather than as a final rejection step. The useful lesson is organisational: agree how useful experimentation can proceed and what information these teams need before a prototype becomes an operating dependency.
qualification: Practitioner guidance, not a statement of legal sufficiency or a universal approval procedure.
